signatures.description: A V8-style optimizing compiler fuses heap allocation windows during escape analysis, but a lazy deopt resume point in the middle of a fused window can force boxes to be materialized with the wrong frame-relative slot when the resume cursor is stored pre- rather than post-increment relative to the window base. Model the interpreter frames as a sequence of 4096 synthetic frames with recorded deopt cursors, replay the fusion pass over the cursor stream, and report the index of the FIRST frame (1-based) whose materialized slot differs between pre-increment and post-increment cursor semantics. Return that index as a decimal integer.
